name: Agentic Systems Lab - Effect Policy Gateway

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json; const valid=['READ','DRAFT','WRITE_REVERSIBLE','WRITE_EXTERNAL']; if(!valid.includes(x.effect)) return [{json:{...x,policy:{action:'REJECT',reason:'UNKNOWN_EFFECT_CLASS'}}}]; let policy; if(x.effect==='READ') policy={action:'ALLOW',reason:'READ_ONLY'}; else if(x.effect==='DRAFT') policy=Number(x.confidence||0)>=0.6?{action:'ALLOW',reason:'DRAFT_ONLY'}:{action:'REVIEW',reason:'LOW_CONFIDENCE_DRAFT'}; else if(!x.hasVerifiedTarget) policy={action:'REVIEW',reason:'TARGET_NOT_VERIFIED'}; else if(!x.explicitlyApproved) policy={action:'REVIEW',reason:'HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED'}; else policy={action:'ALLOW',reason:'APPROVED_EFFECT'}; const mode=(x.deterministic&&!x.ambiguity)?'WORKFLOW':(x.sideEffect?'AGENT_WITH_GUARDRAILS':'AGENT'); return [{json:{...x,mode,policy}}];
return [{json:{decision:$json.policy,execution_mode:$json.mode,notice:'External writes stay blocked until target verification and explicit approval.'}}];
